headline: Colonials Pierce Weathered Expanse and Mooring County Lines
war_summary: Since the previous dispatch, fresh Colonial thrusts have cracked open northern sectors, reclaiming a foothold in Weathered Expanse to leave Wardens holding six bases against one Colonial capture and two vacant ruins amid sustained combat around Crow's Nest, Spirit Watch, and Wightwalk. In Mooring County, an abrupt spike in casualties heralded the fall of The Wind Hills to Colonial arms, carving out a solitary enclave within the otherwise Warden-held territory. Peripheral fighting also flared as Colonials secured Argosa in Godcrofts following a rapid transition. Further west, Stonecradle's strongpoint at The Reach was captured by Colonial forces, reducing Warden authority there to a single redoubt, while Farranac Coast became entirely Colonial-held following the seizure of Transient Valley. Along the Nevish Line, attrition remains staggering with over thirteen thousand combined fallen in the past day, though tactical transfers have paused in recent hours. Meanwhile, Callahan's Passage endures grinding, unmoving border clashes, and combat across Dead Lands and Linn of Mercy has cooled noticeably.
